newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer as dollar demand rises.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer as dollar demand rises.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed around 222-223 per dollar, down from 217.50-219.50 in early trade due to a rise of foreign currency demand on the interbank market, dealers said.

"Considering the longer value date (of Thursday's spot deals) the lev's fall by some four levs from Wednesday would have been normal but this combined with a rise in dollar demand to pressure the lev further down," a dealer said.
The lev closed near 217 per dollar on Wednesday.
The central bank was seen selling dollars at 219.00/50 levs, which partially curbed the lev's fall, traders said.
Central bank officials declined comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
